description:
1. Create a workspace named "temp_workspace", copy /root/matrix.txt into it as "matrix_copy.txt", and record its file size and a checksum/hash in "matrix_copy.metadata" to prove an exact duplicate.  
2. Build a line-offset index file "matrix_lines.idx" for "matrix_copy.txt", verify the index covers the whole file by comparing it to "matrix_copy.metadata", and leave the workspace ready to obtain the total line count.

How many lines are there in /root/matrix.txt
